senses.gloss:
√dī1 'fly'
present: [4.] dī́yati etc. dī́yase 
secondary: intensive: dédīyitavaí 
Represented later by √ḍī. From it may possibly come didyú V.B.

√dī2 'shine'
present: dīdyati (3p.) etc. ádīdet etc. dīdye etc. dī́dayat dīdāyat dīdayante dīdihí didīhí dīdyāsam 
perfect: dīdā́ya dīdaya dīdétha dīdiyus dīdivā́ṅs dīdáyasi etc. dīdáyat etc. dīdidāya? dīdidāsi dīdyasva 
derivatives: -dīti -dīditi RV. dī́di- RV. dī́divi RV. dīdhiti S.+ 
Compare √dīp. Some confusion of forms is made between dīdī and dīdhī.
